reasoning.proof: Hooke restoring force points toward equilibrium with magnitude k|x|; capacitor voltage is q/C for the chosen plate/polarity. The analogy is between linear evolution laws, not between the physical identities or units of the quantities.

For finite force, m dx_dot/dt=F prevents an instantaneous velocity jump; for finite inductor voltage, L di/dt=U prevents an instantaneous current jump. Setting force or inductor voltage to zero gives zero time derivative, not an immediate zero value.

Kinetic energy m v_x^2/2 corresponds to magnetic energy L i^2/2. Elastic energy k x^2/2 corresponds to electric energy q^2/(2C). Thus x corresponds to q, v_x to i, m to L, and k to 1/C; correspondence does not mean numerical or dimensional equality.

i=q_prime is the definition for signed transferred charge increasing in the selected positive current direction. If q instead denotes remaining charge on a discharging plate and current is positive outwards, the sign is reversed. No universal current-direction claim is inferred from this analogy; the displayed positive convention can be used consistently.
